title: Solutions of $a^p=a$ in a local ring of characteristic $p$
statement: Let $p$ be a prime number and let $R$ be a local ring (a commutative ring with exactly one maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$) in which $p\cdot1_R=0$, so that $R$ is an algebra over $\mathbf F_p=\mathbf Z/p\mathbf Z$ via $c\mapsto c\cdot1_R$. If $a\in R$ satisfies $a^p=a$, then $a=c\cdot1_R$ for exactly one $c\in\mathbf F_p$. Equivalently, the map $\mathbf F_p\to\{a\in R:a^p=a\}$, $c\mapsto c\cdot1_R$, is a bijection.

source.place: ## Proof, first sentence (stalk of the kernel of $\wp$); the fact is used without proof in Stacks, Etale Cohomology, Section 0A3J (label section-artin-schreier), where the Artin–Schreier sequence is asserted to be exact

proof.text: Give R characteristic p by CharP.charP_iff_prime_eq_zero, and give its residue field the same characteristic by mapping p=0. Map a^p=a along q=IsLocalRing.residue R. Subfield.mem_bot_iff_pow_eq_self and ZMod.fieldRange_castHom_eq_bot (the Mathlib field-kernel calculation [lem-sc-field-artin-schreier-kernel]) give c : ZMod p with q(a)=ZMod.cast c. The quotient map commutes with the cast, as follows from ZMod.cast_eq_val and map_natCast.

source.place: Tag 0A3J (section-artin-schreier), opening assertion about the kernel; residue-field reduction makes its field calculation applicable to the local ring

proof.text: For every c : ZMod p, ZMod.cast_pow and ZMod.pow_card give (ZMod.cast c : R)^p=ZMod.cast c. Set b=a-ZMod.cast c. Its residue is zero, and sub_pow_char gives b^p=b. Since p is prime, p-1 is positive, so the residue of 1-b^(p-1) is 1 and therefore nonzero. IsLocalRing.residue_ne_zero_iff_isUnit, the residue formulation of [lem-weil-pbc-local-ring-unit-criterion], makes 1-b^(p-1) a unit. Expanding b*(1-b^(p-1)) gives b-b^p=0. Cancel this unit with IsUnit.mul_right_cancel to get b=0 and hence ZMod.cast c=a.

proof.text: ZMod.castHom_injective R applies because R has characteristic p. It gives uniqueness of the constant c once its cast equals a. Conversely, the power equality for every cast follows from ZMod.pow_card and ZMod.cast_pow as above. Thus a^p=a if and only if there is exactly one c : ZMod p with ZMod.cast c=a.
